/__/book.$comment: Internal bookkeeping tool, not a marketing page. It is here purely so the build writes a real document at /__/book carrying its own manifest: a PWA installed from a page whose <link rel=manifest> is swapped in later by JavaScript can capture the site manifest instead, and then launches on the homepage. noindex keeps it out of search.
/__/book.$perf: This route is a staff tool opened cold on a forecourt tablet, so the build treats it differently from the marketing pages. `preloadChunk` names the webpackChunkName given to the lazy import in App.tsx, and makes the build emit a <link rel=preload> for that chunk and every sibling it loads with, collapsing three serial round trips into one. `lean` strips the marketing head this document would otherwise inherit from public/index.html — analytics, chat preconnects, the hero logo preload, and Archivo Black, which the desk never sets.
/__/book.title: Book
/__/book.description: Sales, expenses, loyalty and end-of-day bookkeeping for Jaranow.
/__/book.ogDescription: Sales, expenses, loyalty and end-of-day bookkeeping for Jaranow.
